title: Typeface – Caslon Doric
slide_intent: Help designers choose a weight by comparing identical characters within one family. Holding the characters constant makes changes in stroke weight visible.
strategic_value: The page ties Caslon Doric to the history of Sheffield typefounding and gives the organization a shared voice for both text and display.
demonstration: The explanatory column sits beside Light, Regular and Semibold specimens. Each row shows lowercase, capitals, numerals and punctuation.
practical_value: Compare the three rows before assigning a text or display weight. The copy also identifies the italic counterparts.

content_islands.name: Typeface history and use
content_islands.spec: Set the family history, permitted weights and source information in the narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Matched weight specimens
content_islands.spec: Stack three labeled rows in the larger right column. Keep the character sequence fixed across weights and align each specimen to the same edge.
